generation_method: 100 reference scenarios, four paraphrases each; separate authored wording pools per split
limitation: Synthetic language. Intents, semantic frames and within-split wording repeat; no exact request text crosses splits. Not a real-user benchmark.
test_policy: Wording authored and AI-reviewed before v2 model experiments; final held-out evaluation follows experiments/protocol.json.

review.scope: AI semantic review of authored wording patterns and instantiated values, plus consistency checks on all 400 records

corrections: Distinct train/validation/test wording pools; 37 original cross-split duplicate-request groups removed
Both galleries now have hard and soft inclusion requests
evaluation_policy: Held-out test evaluation explicitly accepts AI-reviewed labels with a fixed hash; this does not imply human verification.
